entrypoints.summary: The ig image build subcommand accepts build options from a YAML gadget manifest and from command-line options or flags that populate buildOptions.

observability.positive_marker: Creation of the report's poc.txt through poc4.txt marker files.

preconditions: The attacker controls build.yml, a build option, or a command-line flag that reaches buildOptions.
The target runs ig image build on the attacker-controlled inputs.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: Semicolon-delimited shell fragment or Make $(shell ...) substitution in an accepted build option or path.
trigger_steps.summary: Supply one of the report's cflags, ebpfsource, wasm, output-directory, or btfhub-archive payload forms and invoke ig image build.

impact.affected_asset: The invoking build host or the image-build container and their accessible resources.
impact.attacker_capability: Execute commands on the local Linux host for --local builds, or in the invoked build container otherwise.
impact.security_effect: Arbitrary command execution during gadget image building.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker able to control build.yml, an image-build option, or a command-line flag can supply values that reach the buildOptions structure; the report identifies CI/CD validation of untrusted gadgets as a typical setting.

buildCmd concatenates buildOptions values into Make variable assignments, including OUTPUTDIR, CFLAGS, EBPFSOURCE, WASM, and BTFHUB_ARCHIVE, while the Makefile templates embed some user-controlled parameters into commands without adequate escaping.
Make and shell substitution interpret supplied make or shell syntax during ig image build; the report demonstrates semicolon-delimited touch commands and $(shell touch ...) payloads.

The interpreted payload executes arbitrary commands on the invoking Linux host with --local, or in the build container when --local is absent; the report's four vectors observe creation of poc.txt through poc4.txt.

failure.operation: Makefile command expansion during ig image build

primary_invariant.kind: data/code separation across make and shell interpretation
primary_invariant.statement: Build option values propagated into Makefile invocations must remain data and must not be interpreted as Make or shell command syntax.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Attacker-controlled buildOptions are concatenated into make variable assignments and then embedded in Makefile commands without adequate escaping, allowing Make or shell expansion.

provenance.source_id: Shielder OSTIF Inspektor Gadget Security Assessment finding 4.1 / CVE-2026-24905

quality.review_notes: The public primary audit report contains code excerpts, four procedural PoCs, and file-creation observations. It reports the finding closed and fixed in v0.51.1, but this bundle lacks the immutable v0.51.1 patch, a regression test, and an immutable upstream advisory URL; affected-version range and exact implementation of the fix are therefore not established.

remediation.invariant_restored: Build options must be constrained or transported so they cannot become executable Make or shell syntax in generated build commands.
mitigation_classes: robust allowlist validation of build-option values
image-build redesign that prevents shell substitution in Makefiles

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Control a full build.yml file, a build option, or a command-line flag that reaches buildOptions.
data_structure_invariants: Values held in buildOptions must not acquire Make or shell syntax semantics when propagated into the build command.
state_context.state_machine: Build options from manifest or CLI are collected in buildOptions, transformed into a make invocation by buildCmd, then consumed by Makefile templates during image building.

target.component: ig image build and its generated Makefile.build templates

oracle.expected_negative: The report does not specify or record a negative-control run; a non-injecting build input should not create the corresponding marker file.
oracle.expected_positive: Under each documented malicious build-option vector, the report observes creation of poc.txt, poc1.txt, poc2.txt, poc3.txt, or poc4.txt during ig image build.
